limits: Shared CI runner observations are not production capacity or an SLO.
The workload exercises the documented 100-row ceiling only.
Database caches are not dropped between workers; no cold-cache claim is made.
Peak RSS is process-lifetime high-water memory, not an allocation by one phase.

excluded: HTTP upload, authentication, signing, rendering, and network time
method.process_model: five sequential fresh Python worker processes
method.replacement_policy: no retries, replacements, or excluded workers
